other_conditions: The applicant must be engaged in the unorganized sector on a self‑employment basis
The applicant must be engaged in one of the 18 family‑based traditional trades listed in the scheme
The applicant must not have availed loans under similar central or state credit‑based schemes (e.g., PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years
Registration and benefits are restricted to one member of the family
benefits_summary: Provides collateral‑free credit up to ₹2 lakhs, skill training, tool grants, digital transaction incentives and marketing support.
